name: one-arm-pronated-dumbbell-extension.html
instructions:
1. Select the desired weight from the rack and sit in an upright position on a flat bench.
2. Lay back keeping the weight close to your chest. Once your back is flat against the pad, press the weights to lockout using a neutral grip.
3. Rotate the dumbbell to a pronated position (thumbs pointing inward) and lower the weight towards your shoulder by unlocking the elbow.
4. Once your forearm reaches parallel or just below, drive the dumbbell back to the starting point by extending the elbow and flexing the tricep.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
